LanguageData.LP_Patron_Asmodeus.label: Asmodeus
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Asmodeus.description: Lord of the Nine Hells, ruler of Nessus, the ninth layer. His contracts are the most beautifully written and the most expensive: what you sign away is your soul.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Asmodeus.boons.0.label: mark of the Lord of Hell
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Asmodeus.boons.0.description: Hostile humanlikes within 5 cells are filled with fear: mental break threshold +15% (refreshed every 5 seconds). Eldritch blast ignite chance raised from 20% to 40%.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Asmodeus.boons.1.label: infernal guard
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Asmodeus.boons.1.description: Ability "Summon horned devil": 1 horned devil serves as your servant for 5 days, cooldown 15 days.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Asmodeus.boons.2.label: erinyes
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Asmodeus.boons.2.description: Immediately gain 1 bound erinyes (starting at level 9) that follows the signer for life, with obedience that never drops. It returns to the Nine Hells when the signer dies or the pact ends.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Asmodeus.demands.0.label: blood sacrifice
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Asmodeus.hiddenClausePool.0.de: The signer's next child is born a tiefling; at eighteen there is a one-in-two chance the Nine Hells take them.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Asmodeus.hiddenClausePool.1.de: Takes 3 soul coins automatically each quarter; if you can't pay, debt +1.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Mephistopheles.label: Mephistopheles
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Mephistopheles.description: Lord of the frozen hell of Cania on the eighth layer, the most learned archduke of the Nine Hells. He collects knowledge, and those who owe him knowledge.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Mephistopheles.boons.0.label: arcana of the frozen hell
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Mephistopheles.boons.0.descrip: Max neural heat +20%; the signer's frost damage (cold, frostbite types) hits add +1 extra stack of chilled to the bone.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Mephistopheles.boons.1.label: ice guard
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Mephistopheles.boons.1.descrip: Ability "Summon ice devil": 1 ice devil serves as your servant for 5 days (leaving normally when the term ends), cooldown 15 days.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Mephistopheles.boons.2.label: forbidden books
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Mephistopheles.boons.2.descrip: At signing and every 60 days after, sends 1 demonology tome and 1 Netherese arcane fragment of a random school.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Mephistopheles.demands.0.label: tithe of knowledge
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Mephistopheles.demands.0.descr: Hand over a book or a scroll every 15 days.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Mephistopheles.hiddenClausePoo: At the start of each winter, the colony gets a 10-day cold snap.
Takes 3 soul coins automatically each quarter; if you can't pay, debt +1.
Hand over a book or a scroll every 15 days.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Dispater.label: Dispater
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Dispater.description: Lord of the iron city of Dis on the second layer: paranoid, wealthy, never leaves his city. He only signs one-year contracts and demands a large sum of silver when they expire.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Dispater.boons.0.label: gold of the iron city
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Dispater.boons.0.description: Drops 1500 silver at signing and every quarter after. When the pact expires, the silver owed doubles (12000).
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Dispater.boons.1.label: iron city artisan
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Dispater.boons.1.description: While the signer is alive and on the colony map, colonists on this map get +25% construction speed.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Dispater.boons.2.label: infernal forge
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Dispater.boons.2.description: Immediately drops an uninstalled infernal forge: burns soul coins, can do every rune anvil recipe at ×1.5 speed.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Dispater.hiddenClausePool.0.de: If you can't pay when it's due, the colony's most valuable building is taken.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Dispater.hiddenClausePool.1.de: Takes an extra 500 silver each quarter; if you can't pay, debt +1.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Dispater.hiddenClausePool.2.de: Takes 3 soul coins automatically each quarter; if you can't pay, debt +1.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Dispater.visibleClauses.0.desc: Hand over 6000 silver when the year is up (12000 if you chose gold of the iron city).
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.label: Glasya
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.description: Mistress of Malbolge on the sixth layer, daughter of Asmodeus and the best lawyer in the Nine Hells. There's no contract she can't untie, except her own.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.boons.0.label: the queen's tongue
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.boons.0.description: Signer's social impact +30%, trade prices improved +15%.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.boons.1.label: see through the clauses
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.boons.1.description: The hidden clauses of all the colony's other pacts are revealed automatically.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.boons.2.label: untie the pact
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.boons.2.description: Immediately dissolve another pact in the colony with no consequences; afterwards this pact's cost cycle ×0.75.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.demands.0.label: secrets
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.demands.0.description: Hand over a secret every 15 days: two random colonists get -20 opinion of each other and mood -5 each (5 days).
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.hiddenClausePool.0.desc: A year after signing, the pact is resold to another lord of the Nine Hells: the boons are kept, but the costs change to the new lord's.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.hiddenClausePool.1.desc: Takes 3 soul coins automatically each quarter; if you can't pay, debt +1.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.visibleClauses.0.label: secrets
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Glasya.visibleClauses.0.descri: Hand over a secret every 15 days: two random colonists get -20 opinion of each other and mood -5 each (5 days).
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.label: Titania
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.description: Queen of the summer court, the brightest sovereign of the Feywild. Her contracts are as generous as summer, and like summer, they change in an instant.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.boons.0.label: summer's grace
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.boons.0.description: On the colony map where the signer is, crops grow +30%; crops in growing zones don't wither from cold.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.boons.1.label: summer's touch
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.boons.1.description: Ability "Summer's touch": heals a colonist's worst wound (not missing parts), cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.boons.2.label: guest of the summer court
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.boons.2.description: Immediately gain 1 satyr or 1 dryad (your choice) who joins as a colonist.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.demands.0.label: summer night's revel
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.demands.0.description: Hold a party or a wedding every 15 days.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.demands.1.label: a secret
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.demands.1.description: Hand over a secret: two random colonists get -20 opinion of each other and mood -5 each (5 days).
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.demands.2.label: a name
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.demands.2.description: A random colonist's name is taken: renamed, mood -6, social impact -20% (10 days).
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.demands.3.label: a beautiful thing
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.demands.3.description: Hand over an artwork of excellent quality or better.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.hiddenClausePool.0.des: Each tree a colonist cuts down: debt +1.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.hiddenClausePool.1.des: Takes one year of the signer's life each year (biological age +1).
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.visibleClauses.0.label: summer night's revel
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Titania.visibleClauses.0.descr: Hold a party or a wedding every 15 days.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.label: Queen of Air and Darkness
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.description: The Queen of Air and Darkness of the winter court, whose face no one has seen. She likes to collect names, and children.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.boons.0.label: winter's veil
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.boons.0.description: Ability "Winter's veil": enemies within 6 cells make a Wisdom save (difficulty rises with the signer's proficiency bonus and Charisma; each point of the target's ability modifier and proficiency bonus gives +5% success) or are charmed for 6 seconds. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.boons.1.label: frost shadow
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.boons.1.description: The signer turns invisible after standing still for 3 seconds; moving or attacking reveals them.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.boons.2.label: redcap servants
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.boons.2.description: Ability "Summon redcaps": 4 redcaps serve as your servants for 3 days, cooldown 1 quarter.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.demands.0.label: a name
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.demands.0.descripti: Takes the name of a random colonist each quarter: renamed, mood -6, social impact -20% (10 days).
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.demands.1.label: a secret
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.demands.1.descripti: Hand over a secret: two random colonists get -20 opinion of each other and mood -5 each (5 days).
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.demands.2.label: winter night's ball
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.demands.2.descripti: Hold a party or a wedding.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.demands.3.label: a year of life
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.demands.3.descripti: Takes one year of the signer's life (biological age +1).
The signer's next child is always swapped for a changeling at birth.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_QueenOfAir.visibleClauses.0.de: Takes the name of a random colonist each quarter: renamed, mood -6, social impact -20% (10 days).
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.label: hag coven
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.description: A coven of three old hags who run errands for the two queens and do business for themselves too. Their boons are stolen from the queens, and the deposit is paid on the spot.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.boons.0.label: summer's grace
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.boons.0.description: On the colony map where the signer is, crops grow +30%; crops in growing zones don't wither from cold.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.boons.1.label: summer's touch
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.boons.1.description: Ability "Summer's touch": heals a colonist's worst wound, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.boons.2.label: guest of the summer court
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.boons.2.description: Immediately gain 1 satyr or 1 dryad who joins as a colonist.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.boons.3.label: winter's veil
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.boons.3.description: Ability "Winter's veil": enemies within 6 cells make a Wisdom save or are charmed for 6 seconds. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.boons.4.label: frost shadow
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.boons.4.description: The signer turns invisible after standing still for 3 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.boons.5.label: redcap servants
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.boons.5.description: Ability "Summon redcaps": 4 redcap servants for 3 days, cooldown 1 quarter.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.demands.0.label: beautiful things
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.demands.0.description: Hand over an artwork of excellent quality or better every 30 days.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.demands.1.label: the hags' tea party
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.demands.1.description: Hold a party or a wedding.
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.demands.2.label: a secret
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.demands.2.description: Hand over a secret: two random colonists get -20 opinion of each other and mood -5 each (5 days).
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.visibleClauses.0.label: deposit
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.visibleClauses.0.descript: Paid on the spot at signing: one year of life, or one eye (your choice).
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.visibleClauses.1.label: beautiful things
LanguageData.LP_Patron_Hags.visibleClauses.1.descript: Hand over an artwork of excellent quality or better every 30 days.
